title: Own-run registration refused when a claim renewal crosses expiry: "named run's claim fence changed; name the source root again"
outcome: A session whose claim is renewed across its expiry either keeps a usable named-root binding for its next registered launcher run, or the refusal tells it exactly what to do before it launches, so that no granted test window is spent on a run that cannot register.
acceptance: Own-run registration refused when a claim renewal crosses expiry: "named run's claim fence changed; name the source root again" is done
